transformer.name: avro-binary
transformer.title: Avro Binary
transformer.description: Transforms from JSon to binary (byte array) using Jackson Avro (supports Avro schema)

transformerIn.description: Needs the Avro schema in the X-Content-Schema exchange property: a Json object or array as text, Avro binary, a JsonNode or a POJO; a Map or a null body fail. Bytes or a stream with the Content-Type application/avro or avro/binary are Avro binary already, and are kept as they are, without the schema

transformerOut.description: Avro binary as bytes; a body that is Avro binary already is kept, also a stream, with its Content-Type
